card.name: Linking words after allergy and patient terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation right after a drug-allergy name (ampicillin, aspirin, penicillin) or after 'each patient' in the opioid risk warning.

modes.label: After allergen names
modes.description: A conjunction, comma or 'to' follows a drug or allergy name in a list of cross-reacting drugs.
modes.example: to ampicillin<< or>> to other beta-lactam antibacterial

modes.label: Possessive after patient
modes.description: The 's after 'assess each patient' in the opioid class warning.
modes.example: assess each patient<<’s>> risk prior to prescribing and reassess all
